description: Experiment-only scene replacements for the smallest screen-prior discriminator. These overrides are loaded only when --experiment-overrides points to this file and do not change normal catalog routing.

technology.robotics.subject: An engineer physically tests and adjusts one generic wheeled or articulated robot on an open indoor test floor, touching a joint or sensor while the robot moves through simple cones or floor markers
technology.robotics.environment: A bright open robotics test floor with mechanical parts, cones, floor tape, robot wheels/joints/sensors, and optionally one simple screenless handheld remote controller; absolutely no desk, monitor, laptop, tablet, phone, television, desktop computer, terminal, code display, or digital panel anywhere
technology.robotics.composition: Make the robot body, engineer's hands, joints, wheels, sensors, and physical test movement fill the storytelling area. The scene must contain zero objects with a display surface.
technology.robotics.camera: Low three-quarter medium-wide field-test view with open floor behind the robot; avoid all desk/workstation framing.
recognition_anchors_add: generic robot body with wheels or articulated joints
hands-on adjustment of a physical sensor or joint
open physical test course with cones or floor markers
must_include_add: zero screen-bearing devices anywhere in frame
override_prompt_additions: This experiment intentionally uses a physically impossible-to-misread screen-free setting: there are no monitors, computers, laptops, tablets, phones, televisions, dashboards, or display panels in the location at all. Do not substitute any digital screen for the physical robot, hands, sensors, joints, wheels, cones, or screenless remote controller.

gaming.game_streaming.subject: A game streamer performs directly to a generic camera while holding a plain unbranded game controller and reacting expressively, with a microphone, headphones, tripod, and studio light making the live-broadcast context clear
gaming.game_streaming.environment: A small screen-free creator studio with a plain wall or acoustic background, camera/tripod, microphone, headphones, controller, and one lighting stand; there is no desk, monitor, television, laptop, desktop computer, tablet, phone display, game screen, or digital panel anywhere
gaming.game_streaming.composition: Treat this as a live performance portrait built from camera, microphone, controller, headphones, and expressive human reaction. No computer equipment or screen-bearing object exists in the scene.
gaming.game_streaming.camera: Three-quarter medium creator-and-camera framing with the controller and microphone prominent and the background completely screen-free.
recognition_anchors_add: microphone, headphones, camera/tripod, and studio light
must_include_add: zero screen-bearing devices anywhere in frame
override_prompt_additions: This experiment intentionally places the streamer in a studio with no screens or computers present at all. Live-streaming recognition must come only from the camera, microphone, headphones, controller, lighting rig, and the creator's on-camera reaction.
